tool_input.subject: Fix SZ bank gate API and yield threshold

Current normal-screen call passes unsupported `yld3=` to `bank_gate`, which accepts only `(symbols, is_bank, metrics=None)`. In `--non-bank`, continue skipping bank gate because banks are already excluded. Otherwise call `bank_gate(final.symbol, _isb)` and separately enforce bank 3-year average dividend yield >5% from `final.yld3`; missing yield fails. Preserve current screening bank classification and output semantics; report exact lines, no tests.
